newsitem.title: GREECE: Quake rocks Athens but causes no damage.
newsitem.headline: Quake rocks Athens but causes no damage.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.3 on the Richter scale shook Athens on Thursday but no damage or injuries were reported, police said.
The Athens Seismological Centre said the epicentre of the quake was in the sea off the beach town of Rafina, 35 km (22 miles) northeast of Athens.
The quake was felt most in the capital's northern suburbs but there was no panic, police said.
